checks.name: Fixtures retain their equations, native spacing, identity, revision, and units
Unsupported source kinds, versions, configurations, and short prefixes fail explicitly
Missing, nonfinite, unpaired, duplicate, and irregular selected samples are rejected
Numeric transform exposes fixed scale-frequency conversion and complex magnitude
Actual finite support, zero extension, and COI are distinct and inspectable
Prefix slices before convolution and future data cannot affect coefficients or display bounds
Known sinusoid matches the analytic response in unpadded interior
Constant has only tiny interior residual while boundary response remains visible
Known rising frequency is recognizable in the useful interior without exact ridge claims

scope: Implementation controls on synthetic calibration; no CANON efficacy or queue-frequency inference
